question: For the 22 frozen fresh public hits, does a wider coefficient-independent coordinate-shift family contain an exact rational relation, and how does residual coordinate height vary with model height?
admission: all parent vector rows with public_relation true, ordered by event_index then vector_index; independent source audit must be PASS
candidate_law: center source coordinates, add shift times p, interpolate A and B from both points; reject singular or wrong-reduction models
model_score_bits: maximum numerator or denominator bit length of A,B,x1,y1,x2,y2
residual_score_bits: maximum numerator or denominator bit length of x and y of aP1+bP2, or zero for identity
residual_digest: SHA-256 of compact JSON array of decimal rational strings [x,y], or SHA-256 of the literal JSON null for identity
selection_rules: minimum residual_score_bits then model_score_bits then lexicographic shift (oracle diagnostic only)
controls: each candidate verifies P1+(-P1)=O and correct reduction; compare the centered and prior selected candidates on the same public hit
claim_boundary: oracle residual minimization uses the known relation vector and is diagnostic; report all candidate failures and exact relation hits; no timing speedup inference
